name: Delek Israel Properties (D.P.) Ltd.
summary: Delek Israel Properties (D.P.) Ltd. engages in the acquisition, development, improvement, management, marketing, and rental of real estate properties in Israel. Its properties include commercial, office, and residential properties. The company also leases fueling complexes, such as gas stations, convenience stores, and related uses comprising car wash, car, and catering services. Delek Israel Properties (D.P.) Ltd. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Yakum, Israel.
